data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool and API errors in two of the models. qwen failed with an HTTP 400 error when auditing the PKGBUILD, and openrouter/free failed to parse the model's response for .SRCINFO and trezor-suite.sh. learnings: Infrastructure errors (HTTP 400, parsing failures) should not force an 'inconclusive' package verdict if the critical files (like PKGBUILD) are successfully and safely audited by another model.
Implement retry logic or fallback parsing for models that fail to output the expected structure, to prevent parse errors from masking successful audits and triggering unnecessary escalations.
